description: Within-line null comparisons versus the locked between-line contrast, and fibrillin swings among replicates of a single cell line
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Within-line null comparisons vs between-line comparisons (PyDESeq2 0.6.0, same filter and model)
labels = ["WT1 vs WT2+WT3","WT2 vs WT1+WT3","WT3 vs WT1+WT2",
          "DMD1 vs DMD2+3","DMD2 vs DMD1+3","DMD3 vs DMD1+2",
          "WT1 vs all DMD","WT2 vs all DMD","WT3 vs all DMD","locked 3 vs 3"]
nsig  = [44, 2, 0, 0, 0, 109, 2140, 2236, 1960, 6265]
kind  = ["null"]*6 + ["cross"]*3 + ["locked"]
fbn1  = [0.051,-0.146,0.100,-0.537,-0.086,0.720,-1.174,-1.302,-1.136,-1.200]
fbn2  = [0.059,-0.169,0.116,-0.736,0.081,0.788,-0.327,-0.474,-0.282,-0.358]
col   = {"null":"#a0aec0","cross":"#4299e1","locked":"#2b6cb0"}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.2))

ax = axes[0]
x = np.arange(len(labels))
ax.bar(x, np.array(nsig)+0.5, color=[col[k] for k in kind], edgecolor="black", lw=0.4)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylim(0.4, 2e4)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=42, ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("genes at BH q < 0.05 (log scale, +0.5 offset)")
ax.set_title("Same pipeline, different contrasts. Comparing replicates within one cell line\n"
             "yields a median of 1 significant gene; comparing the two lines yields thousands.", fontsize=10)
for i, n in enumerate(nsig):
    ax.text(i, n+0.8, str(n), ha="center", fontsize=7.5)
ax.legend([plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=col[k]) for k in col],
          ["within-line null","between-line, 1 vs 3","locked 3 vs 3"], fontsize=8, loc="upper left")

ax = axes[1]
w = 0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2, fbn1, w, color="#2b6cb0", label="FBN1")
ax.bar(x+w/2, fbn2, w, color="#63b3ed", label="FBN2")
ax.axhline(-0.9, color="darkorange", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax.axhline(0, color="black", lw=0.8)
ax.text(9.4, -0.87, "published FBN2 -0.9", color="darkorange", fontsize=8, ha="right", va="bottom")
ax.axvspan(-0.5, 5.5, color="#f7fafc")
ax.text(2.5, 1.05, "replicates of one cell line\n(no biological contrast)", ha="center", fontsize=8.5, color="#4a5568")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=42, ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("log2 fold change")
ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.3)
ax.set_title("DMD3 differs from its own two replicates by +0.72 (FBN1) and +0.79 (FBN2),\n"
             "a fibrillin swing close to the size of the published disease effect.", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=9, loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
